timeline.title: BE – Mechanical Engineering
timeline.text: Built an analytical, systems-first mindset. Picked up OOP with Java, mathematics and CAD — the base that later carried into game architecture.

timeline.title: Transition into Game Development
timeline.text: Pivoted from mechanical engineering into games. Started with Unity, learned C++ deeply, and began shipping playable prototypes across genres.

timeline.title: Shipped 3 Game Prototypes
timeline.text: Designed and built a 2D platformer, a 3D racing game and an endless runner — covering physics, AI, procedural systems and responsive UI end-to-end.

timeline.title: Waiting for the Opportunity
timeline.text: Actively looking for an opportunity to contribute, learn and grow as a game developer while building strong gameplay and system design skills.
